sections.text_helper: Section 16.6.9 "EXTI software interrupt event register 2 (EXTI_SWIER2)" in chapter 16 (Extended interrupts and event controller (EXTI)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 458.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x028
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Contains only register bits for configurable events.
Bits 31:8 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 7 SWI39: Software interrupt on event 39
When EXTI_PRIVCFGR.PRIV39 is disabled, SWI39 can be accessed with unprivileged and
privileged access.
When EXTI_PRIVCFGR.PRIV39 is enabled, SWI39 can only be accessed with privileged
access. Unprivileged write to this SWI39 is discarded, unprivileged read returns 0.
A software interrupt is generated independent from the setting in EXTI_RTSR and
EXTI_FTSR. It always returns 0 when read.
0: Writing 0 has no effect.
1: Writing 1 triggers a rising edge event on event 39. This bit is auto cleared by hardware.
Bits 6:5 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 4 SWI36: Software interrupt on event 36
When EXTI_PRIVCFGR.PRIV36 is disabled, SWI36 can be accessed with unprivileged and
privileged access.
When EXTI_PRIVCFGR.PRIV36 is enabled, SWI36 can only be accessed with privileged
access. Unprivileged write to this SWI36 is discarded, unprivileged read returns 0.
A software interrupt is generated independent from the setting in EXTI_RTSR and
EXTI_FTSR. It always returns 0 when read.
0: Writing 0 has no effect.
1: Writing 1 triggers a rising edge event on event 36. This bit is auto cleared by hardware.
Bit 3 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 2 SWI34: Software interrupt on event 34
When EXTI_PRIVCFGR.PRIV34 is disabled, SWI34 can be accessed with unprivileged and
privileged access.
When EXTI_PRIVCFGR.PRIV34 is enabled, SWI34 can only be accessed with privileged
access. Unprivileged write to this SWI34 is discarded, unprivileged read returns 0.
A software interrupt is generated independent from the setting in EXTI_RTSR and
EXTI_FTSR. It always returns 0 when read.
0: Writing 0 has no effect.
1: Writing 1 triggers a rising edge event on event 34. This bit is auto cleared by hardware.
Bits 1:0 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
